func codingagent.CreateBashTool func(string, ...codingagent.BashToolOptions) (agent.ErasedAgentTool, error)

func codingagent.CreateBashToolDefinition func(string, ...codingagent.BashToolOptions) (codingagent.ToolDefinition, error)

func codingagent.CreateLocalBashOperations func(...codingagent.BashToolOptions) codingagent.BashOperations

func codingagent.GetShellConfig func(...string) (codingagent.ShellConfig, error)

type codingagent.BashToolOptions struct
fields:
- Operations codingagent.BashOperations tag=""
- CommandPrefix string tag=""
- ShellPath string tag=""
- ExposeSessionEnvironment *bool tag=""
- SpawnHook codingagent.BashSpawnHook tag=""

type codingagent.BashToolInput struct
fields:
- Command string tag=""
- Timeout *float64 tag=""

type codingagent.BashToolDetails struct
fields:
- Truncation *agent.TruncationResult tag=""
- FullOutputPath string tag=""

type codingagent.BashExecOptions struct
fields:
- OnData func([]uint8) tag=""
- Timeout *float64 tag=""
- Env map[string]string tag=""

type codingagent.BashExecResult struct
fields:
- ExitCode *int tag=""

type codingagent.BashSpawnContext struct
fields:
- Command string tag=""
- CWD string tag=""
- Env map[string]string tag=""

type codingagent.ShellConfig struct
fields:
- Shell string tag=""
- Args []string tag=""
- CommandTransport string tag=""
